scale_note: Monaco is a single ~0.7 MB extract producing one parquet file per entity. It does not exercise the 250,000-row file rotation, multipart uploads of large files, transient-retry paths, or multi-hour Batch behavior. Those remain covered only by unit tests and historical runs.
